naming.rule: css = '--xp-' + path with dots as hyphens; flutter = <FamilyClass>.<camelCase of the path after the family>; if that starts with a digit the family word leads (space.12 → XpSpacing.space12).

color.surface.window.usage: Content area behind panels: the paper the run sheet sits on.

color.surface.sidebar.usage: Sidebar and the collapsed console strip. Flutter may make it translucent on macOS; this is the opaque fallback and the web value.

color.surface.base.usage: Toolbar / window title area and pane headers.

color.surface.raised.usage: Panels on the window: pipeline rail, ledger, cards, table bodies. Dark: one tint step up, no shadow.

color.surface.sunken.usage: Wells inside a raised panel: text fields, code blocks, meter tracks, skeleton base.

color.surface.overlay.usage: Menus, popovers, command palette, sheets, dialogs, toasts. Dark: two tint steps up, no shadow.

color.surface.hover.usage: Hover fill for rows, sidebar items and tertiary buttons on base, raised or sidebar.

color.surface.inverse.usage: Inverse fill: selected segment, tooltips, the copied-SHA confirmation.

color.surface.selected.usage: Selected sidebar item: sheet plus an inset strong border (see Sidebar).

color.text.primary.usage: Body copy, names, values. Reads on every surface and every status container.

color.text.secondary.usage: Metadata, column heads, runner names, timestamps in chrome. Reads on every surface.

color.text.tertiary.usage: Placeholders, separators set as text, shortcut hints, line numbers in chrome. Reads 4.5:1 on every surface.

color.text.on-accent.usage: Label on an accent fill (primary button, selected segmented item in accent).

color.text.disabled.usage: Disabled control labels only. Exempt from 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3 incidental); never used for information.

color.text.link.usage: Inline links and 'All jobs' style text buttons.

color.border.subtle.usage: Row dividers inside a table or list.

color.border.default.usage: Panel hairlines, pane separators, button outlines (labels identify buttons).

color.border.strong.usage: Boundaries that alone identify a control: text fields, checkboxes, toggles off, selected sidebar item. 3:1 on raised, window and sunken.

color.accent.default.usage: The one primary action per screen (Dispatch…, Approve), focused segmented item, links. Never a status.

color.accent.container.usage: Selected text range and selected table rows; accent-tinted wells.

color.accent.on-accent.usage: Alias of text.on-accent, kept so accent has its own pair.

color.positive.default.usage: Success strokes and fills (meters, rollout bars, diff '+'). As text: raised, window, base.

color.negative.default.usage: Destructive button fill, failure strokes, error underline in the YAML editor.

color.warning.default.usage: The single loud fill: needs-you count badge and Review… button. Same in both themes.

color.info.default.usage: Running strokes: running node border, progress bars, follow-tail caret.

color.focus.ring.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset in the surface colour. 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

color.selection.default.usage: Text selection highlight and multi-select rows. Primary text stays legible on it.

color.agent.ink.usage: Agent marker border (1px dashed), robot icon and label. Deliberately colourless: it says who, not how things are going.

color.agent.container.usage: Agent marker fill when it sits on a status container or in a dense table; transparent elsewhere.

color.status.neutral.container.usage: Status container (neutral). Nothing to do and nothing wrong: queued, waiting, skipped, cancelled, draft, offline, unknown.

color.status.neutral.on-container.usage: Status icon + label on status.neutral.container, and inline on raised, window, base and overlay.

color.status.info.container.usage: Status container (info). Something is moving: running, building, in review, processing, busy, updating, scan info.

color.status.info.on-container.usage: Status icon + label on status.info.container, and inline on raised, window, base and overlay.

color.status.attention.container.usage: Status container (attention). A human must act: waiting for approval, ready to submit, pending developer release, secrets locked.

color.status.attention.on-container.usage: Status icon + label on status.attention.container, and inline on raised, window, base and overlay.

color.status.positive.container.usage: Status container (positive). Done and good: succeeded, approved, live, published, verified, connected, idle runner.

color.status.positive.on-container.usage: Status icon + label on status.positive.container, and inline on raised, window, base and overlay.

color.status.negative.container.usage: Status container (negative). Broken or refused: failed, rejected, denied, not approved, expired credential, unreachable, scan error.

color.status.negative.on-container.usage: Status icon + label on status.negative.container, and inline on raised, window, base and overlay.

color.status.caution.container.usage: Status container (caution). Degraded but not blocked: interrupted, reconnecting, expiring soon, missing credential, scan warning.

color.status.caution.on-container.usage: Status icon + label on status.caution.container, and inline on raised, window, base and overlay.

color.status.merged.container.usage: Status container (merged). Terminal success of a release: merged into main.

color.status.merged.on-container.usage: Status icon + label on status.merged.container, and inline on raised, window, base and overlay.

color.log.surface.usage: Console / log viewer background. Only surface where ANSI colour may appear.

color.log.gutter.usage: Line-number gutter and sticky step header.

color.log.dim.usage: Line numbers, timestamps, ANSI dim on default text.

color.log.stderr-row.usage: Row tint for stderr lines when 'stderr only' is off.

color.log.error-row.usage: Row tint for the line 'Jump to error' lands on and lines matched as errors.

color.log.match-active.usage: Current search match (text stays log.text in light, #141412 in dark via log.match-active-text).

color.log.match-active-text.usage: Text on the current search match.

color.log.current-row.usage: The streaming tail line while following.

color.code.surface.usage: YAML editor background (same as the log).

color.code.gutter.usage: Line-number gutter in the YAML editor.

color.log.ansi.black.usage: ANSI black (SGR 30) on log.surface. Remapped in dark so it stays legible.

color.log.ansi.white.usage: ANSI white (SGR 37) on log.surface. Remapped in light so it stays legible.

color.log.ansi.bright-white.usage: ANSI bright-white (SGR 97) on log.surface. Remapped in light so it stays legible.

color.code.error.usage: Wavy error underline and gutter marker.

type.hero.usage: The one big thing a screen is for: a release's state, a job's result, a pending approval's action. One per screen. Versions inside it switch to type.hero-code.

type.hero-code.usage: Version or build inside a hero line. Tabular figures.

type.headline.usage: Screen titles inside the content area (app header, sheet title).

type.title.usage: Panel titles, toolbar title, card titles.

type.title-sm.usage: Row titles, sidebar selected project, flavor names.

type.body-strong.usage: Emphasis inside body and button labels.

type.caption.usage: Metadata under a row title, helper text, timestamps in prose.

type.label.usage: Section and column labels, set in mono caps. Never for sentences.

type.code.usage: Versions, build numbers, SHAs, bundle IDs, tags, durations, sizes. Tabular figures, copyable.

type.code-lg.usage: Versions in the ledger's cells and card headers.

type.mono.usage: Log lines. ANSI bold = weight 600; dim = log.dim colour.

space.4.usage: Icon to label in badges and chips.

space.6.usage: Icon to label in rows and buttons; stacked label + value.

space.8.usage: Gap between controls in a toolbar group, between chips.

space.10.usage: Row inline padding (sidebar, lists), node padding.

space.12.usage: Table cell padding, card inner gaps.

space.16.usage: Panel padding, gap between toolbar groups.

space.20.usage: Content-area side padding, pane header inset.

space.24.usage: Gap between stacked panels at comfortable size.

radius.md.usage: Buttons, fields, rows, panels, pipeline nodes.

radius.lg.usage: Popovers, menus, sheets, dialogs, toasts, command palette.

border.width.emphasis.usage: Pipeline wires; dashed for not-yet-reached edges.

border.focus-offset.usage: Gap between control and focus ring, painted in the surface colour.

border.running.usage: Extra inset ring on a running node (2px total, info.default).

size.row.default.usage: Default list and table row height (sidebar project rows 40px: two lines).

size.row.compact.usage: Compact density (View ▸ Compact Rows, ⌃⌘=). Tables, log groups, runner lists; never the sidebar.

size.control.sm.usage: Inline buttons in rows, keycaps rows, chips.

size.control.md.usage: Default buttons, fields, segmented controls, search.

size.control.lg.usage: Sheet and dialog footer buttons, the approval hero buttons.

size.toolbar.height.usage: Window title area + toolbar (traffic lights live in it).

size.console.height.usage: Console default height; min 160px; collapsed strip 34px.

size.icon.xs.usage: Icons inside type.code and type.label runs.

size.icon.sm.usage: Status icons in badges, rows, nodes.

window.min.width.usage: Minimum window width. Sidebar 200px, console collapsed to its strip by default, ledger drops Patches column into the row menu.

window.min.height.usage: Minimum window height. Console max 40% of height.

window.comfortable.width.usage: Design reference width. Sidebar 232px, horizontal pipeline, console 268px.

window.large.width.usage: Large (16-inch MBP default). Content grows; a job view adds the step list beside the log.

window.breakpoint.pipeline-vertical.usage: Content width below which the pipeline graph switches to its vertical layout (also the menu bar extra and narrow web).

window.breakpoint.sidebar-collapse.usage: Window width below which the sidebar starts hidden (⌃⌘S to show as overlay).

elevation.0.usage: Everything on the window: panels are flat with hairlines. No cards inside cards.

elevation.1.usage: Light only: the selected segmented item and toolbar buttons pressed. Dark: surface.selected tint.

elevation.2.usage: Popovers, menus, toasts, tooltips. Dark: surface.overlay tint + border.default.

elevation.3.usage: Sheets, dialogs, command palette. Dark: surface.overlay + border.strong at 1px + scrim behind.

motion.duration.instant.usage: Reduce Motion replacement for every non-essential transition.

motion.duration.fast.usage: Hover and press fills, toggle thumb, checkbox mark.

motion.duration.base.usage: Sidebar selection, segmented control thumb, status crossfade.

motion.duration.moderate.usage: Popover, menu, toast enter; sheet exit.

motion.duration.slow.usage: Sheet enter, pipeline progress fill, pane collapse.

motion.duration.spin.usage: One turn of the running arc (linear, infinite).

motion.duration.pulse.usage: Reconnecting / updating rotation (slower than running so they read differently).

motion.easing.standard.usage: Default for moves inside the window. Flutter: Cubic(0.2, 0, 0, 1).

motion.easing.enter.usage: Things arriving: sheet, popover, toast. Flutter: Cubic(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1).

motion.easing.linear.usage: Spinners and progress that tracks real time. Flutter: Curves.linear.

job.waiting-runner.label: Waiting for runner
job.waiting-runner.note: No runner with the capability and a free slot. Says which capability.

job.waiting-approval.label: Waiting for approval
job.waiting-approval.note: Same pair as approval.pending: the job is blocked on a human.

job.running.label: Running
job.running.note: The only state with the running arc. Shows elapsed time.

job.failed.label: Failed
job.failed.note: Row offers Jump to error and Re-run (⌘R).

job.skipped.label: Skipped · already done
job.skipped.note: Resume-from-step skipped it; the label always carries the reason.

job.interrupted.label: Interrupted
job.interrupted.note: Engine restarted mid-job. Offers Resume from step.

release.building.label: Building
release.building.note: A job for this release is running: same treatment as job.running.

release.uploaded.label: Uploaded
release.uploaded.note: Builds are in the stores, not yet submitted.

release.in-review.label: In review
release.in-review.note: At least one store is reviewing. External wait: never animated.

release.approved.label: Approved
release.approved.note: Approved by both stores, not yet live.

release.live.label: Live
release.live.note: Both stores live. The Merge button unlocks.

appstore.ready-to-submit.label: Ready to submit
appstore.ready-to-submit.note: Needs a human (or an approved agent request) to submit.

appstore.waiting-review.label: Waiting for review
appstore.waiting-review.note: Queued at Apple. Not ours to act on.

appstore.pending-release.label: Pending developer release
appstore.pending-release.note: Approved, waiting for you to release.

appstore.rejected.label: Rejected
appstore.rejected.note: Shows the resolution centre reason when the API returns it.

appstore.phased.label: Phased rollout · day 3 of 7
appstore.phased.note: Live to a share of users; lane shows the 7-day meter.

appstore.unknown.label: Unknown · live 5.3.6
appstore.unknown.note: No App Store Connect key: only the public live version is known. Manual buttons appear.

play.not-sent.label: Not sent for review
play.not-sent.note: Same meaning as App Store 'Ready to submit'.

play.approved-unpublished.label: Approved · not published
play.approved-unpublished.note: Same meaning as App Store 'Pending developer release'.

approval.pending.label: Pending
approval.pending.note: The only status allowed the loud warning fill (in the needs-you bar and badge).

approval.expired.label: Expired
approval.expired.note: Nobody decided in time; the requester must ask again.

runner.busy.label: Online · busy 2/3
runner.busy.note: Spins only while a job runs on it; slot meter shows load.

runner.offline.label: Offline
runner.offline.note: Last heartbeat shown as relative time.

runner.lost.label: Lost mid-job
runner.lost.note: Heartbeat stopped while a job was running.

engine.reconnecting.label: Reconnecting
engine.reconnecting.note: Banner after 3 s; data stays visible.

engine.unreachable.label: Unreachable · cached
engine.unreachable.note: Data is the last snapshot; every action is disabled and says why.

engine.secrets-locked.label: Secrets locked
engine.secrets-locked.note: Builds that sign or upload wait until unlocked.

scan.info.label: Info
scan.info.note: Always with a fix or 'Nothing to do'.

credential.expired.label: Expired
credential.expired.note: Covers 'rejected by Apple/Google' with the reason.

credential.missing.label: Missing
credential.missing.note: Becomes a blocking error only in a dispatch that needs it.

agentMarker.label: AGENT · <agent name>
agentMarker.labelStyle: type.label (mono caps) for AGENT, type.body-strong for the name
